summary: Public projects created on 20 October 2026: 4 repos and 2 datasets.
intro: Android app work covered a thin fork template with weekly upstream merges and signed releases, a public F-Droid repository, and an offline family first-aid app for Israel. Other repositories hid encrypted messages in spoken sentences. Datasets graded Israel-Palestine framing outputs and labelled unsolicited outreach emails.

projects.name: Android Thin Fork Autosync
projects.description: Template for a thin downstream fork of an active Android app: narrow hooks, weekly auto-merge of upstream releases, seam checks, signed release APKs via GitHub Actions

projects.name: F Droid Public Repo
projects.description: Public F-Droid repo for Daniel Rosehill's Android apps, served from Cloudflare R2 at apps.bydanielrosehill.com

projects.name: Family First Aid Android
projects.description: Offline Android first-aid app for families in Israel (MDA / Hatzalah): adult + child protocols, interactive decision flows, spaced review. Not medical advice.

projects.name: LLM Spoken Steganography
projects.description: LLM hides an encrypted message in the sentence openers of a mundane podcast that survives TTS -> air -> STT. Grew out of My Weird Prompts #6141.

projects.name: Israel Palestine Framing Eval Runs
projects.description: Model outputs and grades from runs of Israel-Palestine-Framing-Eval. The prompts are a separate dataset, danielrosehill/Israel-Palestine-Framing-Eval.

projects.name: Pseudo Personalised Outreach
projects.description: Real unsolicited emails sent to one person, labelled genuine or pseudo_personalised, with every sender identity replaced by a plausible fake.
